lineage.description: Building footprints and attributes were extracted from OpenStreetMap volunteered geographic information for Jordan. Data quality was assessed using AI-mapping estimates and temporal metadata (last edit dates, update frequency). The dataset represents approximately 232.3 thousand mapped buildings with structural attributes including building type, levels, and materials, suitable for exposure assessment in disaster risk analysis.
